news-korea-econ.title: Pro-Amnesty Groups Fund Wall of 20,000 Lawsuits to Block Migrant Deportations
news-korea-econ.description:
Pro-migration activists have funded some 20,000 lawsuits to release roughly 17,300 illegal migrants -- including many criminals -- mostly with the aid of judges nominated by President Joe Biden.
